key_insight: AI agents improved quantum circuit compilation through iterative program optimization, with every result certified by a frozen, exact verifier.
engineering_relevance: The approach could lower quantum implementation costs while making automated optimization results independently checkable.
method: An agent formulates the optimization challenge with a researcher and builds an exact verifier.
Validate the verifier against a solved case, deliberately broken solutions and published results, then freeze it.
Agents iteratively improve programs against a fixed evaluator and record reusable insights in human-readable notes.
evidence_signal: Across fermion-to-qubit encoding, Hamiltonian layout and unitary synthesis, agents reduced optimized costs by up to 73% at the largest tested sizes and outperformed a state-of-the-art fermion-to-qubit encoding optimizer.
watch_item: The method requires exact, efficient verification; reported cost reductions do not by themselves establish end-to-end hardware speedups.
paper_title: Automating quantum circuit optimization with AI agents
